description: This Java source file defines an Android activity class 'MorseCode' which demonstrates vibrating the device with Morse Code for a given string. It sets up a UI with a button and text display, and when the button is clicked, it converts the displayed text to a Morse Code pattern and vibrates accordingly.

classes.name: MorseCode
classes.description: An Android activity that vibrates the device using Morse Code representation of text entered by the user.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout and click listener for the button.

methods.name: mClickListener
methods.description: OnClickListener that retrieves text from TextView, converts it to Morse Code vibration pattern, and triggers the vibration.
